title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, tends to produce sparse solutions, meaning it often results in some coefficients being exactly zero. This is useful for feature selection.

title: Comparing the Versions
text: Look at the coefficients in each version. Which version has coefficients that are zero? This might indicate the effect of L1 regularization.

title: Identifying the Sparse Solution
text: Which version has one or more coefficients that are exactly zero?
